description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Space Wolves BATTLE INSTINCTS (Saga of the Great Wolf, 1 CP) — WP-S3. Fixture sw11e_s3_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Wolves, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sw11e_s3_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Wolves player gets all three Space Wolves detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. The Ork Flash Gitz shoot Grey Hunters B (the shooting panel's SHOOT); enemy_has_shot opens for the Space Wolves player; a real click on 'Use on Grey Hunters' spends 1 CP (D3 rolled: a normal move of up to D3+3") and opens the reactive-move panel; real clicks on Auto-move and Confirm move the Grey Hunters within range of obj_nml_2.
